title: Tiana and the frog.
lines: A girl lives in a city full of music.
She makes the tastiest soup and the tastiest beignets.
Those are sweet pastries with sugar.
That's why she works very hard.
She saves every coin in a tin.
One evening there's a big fancy-dress party.
Tiana bakes beignets for the party.
She's wearing a beautiful blue dress.
On the balcony she sees a frog.
A sorcerer turned me into a frog.
If a princess gives me a little kiss, I'll be a prince again.
I'm not a princess, says Tiana.
But the frog begs so sweetly.
Tiana turns into a frog too!
They end up in a big swamp.
In the swamp they meet a crocodile.
They also meet a little firefly.
Ray is in love with the most beautiful star in the sky.
She's an old wise woman who can do magic.
At first he can't do it.
Mama Odie lives in a boat in a tree.
She says: What you need isn't what you want.
You have to find out what's really important.
But even more she wants to be with Naveen.
Tiana and Naveen get married in the swamp.
Tiana is now a princess, because she has married a prince.
They give each other a little kiss.
And up in the sky Ray's star is shining.
